meaning: Advancement priority only. Collector mint transactions must not call the randomness provider; no provider is production certified by this file.

chainlink_vrf_v2_5_direct_native.reason: R1 thin callback passed; current official Ethereum/Base deployments exist; request funding is atomic per request using the wrapper live native quote; no shared subscription attribution gap or independent user-contribution source is required.

pyth_entropy_v2.reason: R3 thin callback and exact getFeeV2 payment passed and fit Phase 2C accounting, but the full-custom security posture still requires a production-grade independent user contribution source and current official Entropy deployment evidence is Base-focused in the R3 snapshot.

chainlink_vrf_v2_5_subscription_native.reason: R2 callback architecture passed but exact per-request provider payment is only known after callback charging, leaving shared-liquidity attribution/reconciliation unresolved.

supra_dvrf_v3.reason: R4 callback/retry architecture passed, but the client-wallet prepaid subscription remains separate from collection reservation escrow, exact collection attribution/reconciliation is unresolved, and the reviewed public audit index did not identify a V3-specific Solidity audit.

dice_entropy_v10.reason: Native Robinhood deployment and exact per-request native fee are live-proven. R8 advances a storage-only upstream callback with permissionless local exact-word replay; live zero-default mode does not assume provider-side callback retry.

chains.secondaryCandidateNote: Pyth is not an automatic runtime fallback. It is a separate research/contingency candidate that would need its own production gates closed before any governed provider switch.

chains.note: Dice becomes the Robinhood advancement candidate, not production-enabled. A Dice outage can delay settlement but must never revert an already successful collector mint reservation or create a reroll.
